title: POST /api/projects/:id/milestones — create milestone
description: Create a new milestone under a project. Sort order defaults to the end of the list.

steps.description: Create milestone Zod schema and handler
steps.details: In validators/milestones.ts: createMilestoneSchema = z.object({ name: z.string().min(1).max(255), description: z.string().max(2000).optional(), dueDate: z.string().datetime().optional(), status: z.enum(['pending','in_progress','completed']).optional() }). Handler: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Find max sort_order for project milestones. 3) Insert milestone with sort_order = max + 1. 4) Return 201.
Create server/src/routes/milestones.ts. Mount in index.ts: app.use('/api/projects/:id/milestones', requireAuth, milestonesRouter). Pass req.params.id via mergeParams: true on the router.
Create 3 milestones for a project, verify sort_orders are 1, 2, 3. Verify 400 on empty name.
